Rebecca has a tough week after learning some news about Josh and someone surprising shows up.
It is the holidays and Rebecca's mom decides to come visit her in West Covina.
In an attempt to impress, Rebecca rents a party bus to take a group to the beach.
Rebecca realizes the perfect opportunity to remind Josh about the amazing times they had at camp.
